rationales: Walther Flemming is known for work on cell division, not ATP discovery.
Calvin is associated with the photosynthetic carbon cycle, not ATP discovery.
Karl Lohmann discovered ATP in 1929.
Lavran is not the scientist credited with discovering ATP.
Carbon dioxide is a major product formed when food is oxidized during respiration.
Water is also produced in respiration, but carbon dioxide is the best answer among these choices for the oxidation product.
ATP stores some of the energy released, but it is not the substance into which food is oxidized.
Oxygen is used in aerobic respiration rather than produced by oxidation of food.
The pericycle lies inside the root and does not form root hairs.
Root hairs are extensions of epidermal cells.
The endodermis is an inner root layer, not the source of root hairs.
The cortex lies beneath the epidermis and does not form root hairs.
Physiology studies the functions of organisms and their parts.
Anatomy studies the structure of organisms and their parts.
Parasitology studies parasites and their relationships with hosts.
Palaeontology studies fossils and remains of extinct organisms.
Epithelial tissue forms glands and their secretory linings.
Muscular tissue contracts to produce movement rather than forming glands.
Connective tissue supports and connects body structures but does not form glandular tissue.
Nervous tissue receives and transmits signals rather than forming glands.
Anatomy studies the structure of organisms, not gene insertion methods.
Physiology studies how organisms function, not genetic engineering procedures.
Biotechnology uses biological systems and techniques to insert genes into organisms such as bacteria.
Pharmacology studies drugs and their effects.

Volvox is a colony of eukaryotic cells.
Volvox is generally classified as colonial rather than a truly multicellular organism.
Malaria is not caused by bacteria.

Malaria is not caused by a virus.

Temperate regions generally have less biodiversity than tropical regions.
Tropical regions have the richest biodiversity, especially in tropical rainforests.
Polar regions have relatively low biodiversity due to harsh conditions.
Deserts generally support less biodiversity than tropical regions.
Polysaccharides are not the main products synthesized by smooth endoplasmic reticulum.
Proteins are mainly synthesized by ribosomes, often on rough endoplasmic reticulum.
Smooth endoplasmic reticulum synthesizes lipids.
DNA is not synthesized by smooth endoplasmic reticulum.
Metaphase is broadly similar in plant and animal cells.
Karyokinesis occurs by broadly similar stages in plant and animal cells.
Telophase is broadly similar in plant and animal cells.

Cytoplasm does not contain chlorophyll in a leaf cell.

Bicarbonates help neutralize acid but are not formed from pepsinogen.
Hydrochloric acid activates pepsinogen but is not produced from it.
Gastrin is a hormone that stimulates gastric secretion, not a product of pepsinogen.
